description: This is a PHP source file defining the EmployeeEducationDao class within the OrangeHRM system, responsible for data access operations related to employee education records such as create, retrieve, delete, and search functionalities.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for handling employee education data.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Persists an EmployeeEducation entity to the database.

methods.name: getEmployeeEducationById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific EmployeeEducation record by employee number and education ID.

methods.name: getExistingEmpEducationIdsByEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches existing education record IDs for an employee based on a list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeEducations
methods.description: Deletes multiple EmployeeEducation records for an employee based on provided IDs.

methods.name: searchEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Performs a search for EmployeeEducation records based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeEducationPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator for employee education search results.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeEducationsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employee education records matching search criteria.
